slides.title: Domain Name System (DNS)
slides.body:
What is Name Space ?
Definition
A Name Space is a system used to assign unique, meaningful names to resources in a network (computers, websites, services)
Why Name Space?
Helps us identify devices easily
Avoids confusion when many systems exist
Makes the Internet organized

DNS (Domain Name System) handles this translation process

DNS is the Internet's phonebook, mapping domain names (e.g., google.com) to IP addresses(192.168.1.1)
